mapper.select: SELECT wm.id,wm.user_id,u.user_name,u.phone_number,wm.department,wm.title,wm.role,wm.status,wm.created_at,wm.last_active_at FROM workspace_members wm JOIN users u ON u.id=wm.user_id WHERE wm.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members access WHERE access.workspace_id=wm.workspace_id AND access.user_id=#{userId} AND access.status='ACTIVE') ORDER BY wm.created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_members SET role=#{role} WHERE id=#{memberId} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND role<>'OWNER' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND role IN('OWNER','ADMIN') AND status='ACTIVE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_members(workspace_id,user_id,role) VALUES(#{workspaceId},#{userId},#{role}) ON CONFLICT (workspace_id,user_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO workspace_invitations(workspace_id,phone_number,department,title,invite_note,role,token_hash,invited_by,expires_at) SELECT #{workspaceId},#{phoneNumber},#{department},#{title},#{inviteNote},#{role},#{tokenHash},#{userId},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '7 days' WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND role IN('OWNER','ADMIN') AND status='ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT i.id,i.workspace_id,i.phone_number,i.department,i.title,i.invite_note,i.role,i.invited_by,i.status,i.expires_at,i.created_at,w.name AS workspace_name FROM workspace_invitations i JOIN workspaces w ON w.id=i.workspace_id WHERE i.phone_number=#{phoneNumber} AND i.status='PENDING' AND i.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND w.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY i.created_at DESC

SELECT i.id,i.workspace_id,i.phone_number,i.department,i.title,i.invite_note,i.role,i.invited_by,i.status,i.expires_at,i.created_at,w.name AS workspace_name FROM workspace_invitations i JOIN workspaces w ON w.id=i.workspace_id WHERE i.id=#{id} AND i.phone_number=#{phoneNumber} AND i.status='PENDING' AND i.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND w.status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: WITH accepted AS (UPDATE workspace_invitations SET status='ACCEPTED' WHERE id=#{id} AND phone_number=#{phoneNumber} AND status='PENDING' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING workspace_id, role) INSERT INTO workspace_members(workspace_id,user_id,role,status) SELECT workspace_id,#{userId},role,'ACTIVE' FROM accepted ON CONFLICT (workspace_id,user_id) DO UPDATE SET role=EXCLUDED.role,status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE workspace_invitations SET status='DECLINED' WHERE id=#{id} AND phone_number=#{phoneNumber} AND status='PENDING' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE workspace_invitations SET status='REVOKED' WHERE id=#{invitationId} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND status='PENDING' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND role IN('OWNER','ADMIN') AND status='ACTIVE')
